research_question: How does a wind turbine convert wind energy into electrical energy?

sources.title: How Do Wind Turbines Work?
notes: Wind creates lift on blades; the rotor turns a shaft that drives a generator directly or through a gearbox.

sources.title: Explore a Wind Turbine: Text Version
notes: Generated electricity goes through power electronics or electrical equipment, transformers, substations and transmission lines before distribution.

sources.title: Wind Energy Basics
notes: Wind originates from uneven solar heating, surface differences and Earth's rotation; siting, wind variability and grid connection shape output.
